implementation.kind: Private immutable payload now distinguishes calibration fit/table, histogram and profile with explicit axis captions. No calibration record/model is manufactured for generic plots; annotation/model controls are absent. Existing public core APIs/SDK unchanged.
implementation.histograms: Legacy histogram command keeps its original raw bin producer/ROI path. Scientific panel adds Interactive plot, also show_histogram_plot, using its last immutable DatasetHistogramResult with source title/ID captured before preference/workflow publication. No recalculation/source read; original pooled target, raw counts and panel log1p thumbnail/statistics/replay remain unchanged. Interactive plot displays raw counts with independent axes.
implementation.precision: Full producer double edges and uint64 counts retained; bars use double drawing coordinates. Exact counts are available in diagnostics and CSV, including counts above2^53. Legacy histogram display previously converted bins/counts to float; new display uses retained producer values. No raw histogram count recomputation.
implementation.profiles: Original grayscale line/polyline sampling, physical scalar X/Y distance, configured sample count, float-rounded displayed samples and shared-junction omission preserved. Grayscale plane is now prepared once per profile instead of once per segment. Distance and raw value captions explicit; no new density-calibration interpretation.
implementation.csv: Scientific histogram plots call existing dataset_histogram_csv byte-for-byte (bin/lower/upper/count). Legacy histogram retains x,y columns and bin capacity above65536 with exact decimal counts. Profiles retain x,y and round-trip precision for the existing float-rounded samples. Calibration series,x,y format and immutable file callbacks preserved.
implementation.interaction: Legacy histogram/profile now use the same viewport, pan/zoom/rectangle, axes/ticks, applicable style, snapshot and PNG controls as calibration plots. Profile style exposes curve width/color; histogram exposes bar color. Generic aliases show/set_plot_limits, zoom_plot_rectangle, show/set_plot_style, show_plot_image_export/export_plot_image and export_plot_csv preserve original calibration action names. IDs and revision guards reused.
implementation.ownership: Scientific plots open as source-independent snapshots. Reopening one calculated result reuses a single immutable payload/lease through one weak hint; per-window view/style/controller leases remain independent. Weak hint retains no data after last plot/export owner. Shared histogram result has no retained source selection/provider/document. Source/panel closure leaves plot usable; last managed owner releases lease.
implementation.diagnostics: Generic live reports use plot; existing calibration fit_plot remains compatible. Profiles expose series_x/y; histograms expose exact counts/bin_edges without duplicate calibration sample vectors. plot_samples remains legacy generic count. Managed retained/output memory is not total RSS and excludes pre-existing panel results/source/provider/ImGui/driver/transport allocations.
